resources.string: BADAN reads your health data from Health Connect and keeps it on this phone, so you have one place that holds your own history. You choose what to share, one group at a time, and you can change your mind later.
Steps, distance, floors climbed, and energy burned — so your day can be shown as it actually happened rather than as an estimate.
Heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, breathing rate, blood oxygen, and skin temperature — so BADAN can show your typical ranges and how today compares to them.
Your sleep sessions and stages — so nights can be shown next to the days around them.
Weight, body fat, lean body mass, and cardio fitness — so long-term measurements sit alongside the rest of your history instead of in a separate app.
Your recorded workouts — so each session keeps its own summary and can be compared with how you slept and recovered around it.
The route saved with a workout you already finished. BADAN never follows where you are and never records a new route, and routes are never included in an export unless you turn them on yourself.

Lets BADAN pick up new readings in the background so what you see is already up to date when you open the app. Background updates usually run within the hour; opening BADAN always refreshes right away.
